items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-05
items.q: I haven't heard Raymond Burke in person. I've heard him on records.

ctx.x: I've been there every night I've been here and the basket that goes out through the back door is, they could buy a piano every night. I mean, you know, they're, they're not losing anything. And, and this, that sort of thing for one, that, that, that, they, they don't have a good piano for the musicians to play on, it's just absolutely ridiculous. And then this business of picking blokes to play there is, it's equally ridiculous. When you put fellas with someone else, just because, um, he's well liked around…
That's what a lot of people say. I haven't heard.
